description: This PHP file defines the LangStringHelper class, which provides utility functions for managing language strings and localization data in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It interacts with a database to perform CRUD operations on language string records, including retrieval, insertion, updating, and deletion, often based on language groups or customizations.

classes.name: LangStringHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing translation/language string data, including CRUD operations, group management, and reading/writing language string files in YAML format.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the helper with a database connection.

methods.name: createQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new Doctrine QueryBuilder instance.

methods.name: getLangHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LanguageHelper instance.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a language group by its name.

methods.name: deleteNonCustomizedLangStrings
methods.description: Deletes language strings that are not marked as customized within a specific group.

methods.name: getLangStringIdsForGroup
methods.description: Fetches all language string IDs belonging to a specific group.

methods.name: getNonCustomizedLangStringIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of language strings that are not customized in a group.

methods.name: insertOrUpdateLangStrings
methods.description: Reads language strings from a YAML file and inserts or updates them in the database.

methods.name: getLangStringIdByValueAndGroup
methods.description: Finds a language string ID by its value and optional group ID.

methods.name: getLangStringIdByUnitIdAndGroup
methods.description: Finds a language string ID by its unit ID and group ID.

methods.name: saveLangString
methods.description: Inserts a new language string record into the database.

methods.name: updateLangString
methods.description: Updates an existing language string record identified by its ID.
